name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
description: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 provides a taxonomy of cybersecurity outcomes and a methodology for organizations to assess and improve their ability to prevent, detect, and respond to cyber attacks. Version 2.0 adds a new Govern function.

domains.name: Govern
domains.description: The organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored

domains.name: Identify
domains.description: The organization's current cybersecurity risks are understood

domains.name: Protect
domains.description: Safeguards to manage the organization's cybersecurity risks are used

domains.name: Detect
domains.description: Possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises are found and analyzed

domains.name: Respond
domains.description: Actions regarding a detected cybersecurity incident are taken

domains.name: Recover
domains.description: Assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident are restored

metadata.notes: Added Govern function; expanded supply chain and cloud considerations
